rationale: bugs_open/309's LAST open half. CLC-018 shipped the BIRTH gate (sourceVocabularyIssues, live v1.0.1314) which refuses a generated component whose input_schema declares a source the platform cannot resolve. It is holding: MEASURED 2026-08-22, zero offending components created or updated since it went live. But nothing has ever asked the same question of the components ALREADY in the database, and the birth gate structurally never can — a component is routinely inserted or altered by a hand-written migration or hand SQL, which never passes through store_generated_component_action (a standing LANDMINE entry, and exactly how the motivating component blog-listing_pre_037 got there). MEASURED at the live DB today: 69 fields across 17 active components declare a source that resolves nowhere (51 phantom site_specs aspects, 14 unregistered query fields, 4 outside the vocabulary); SIX of those components are live on 46 page instances. The one runtime detector of this exact silence, STRUCTURAL_KEY_CARRY_MISS, is 28 rows all-history, last written 2026-08-17, and is one of the codes bugs_open/358 measures as having no automated consumer and a 30-day retention delete — and it only ever fires when a page is BUILT, so the eleven dormant components are invisible to it for ever. The concept register's own CLC-018 entry names this audit as the unbuilt half and prescribes its shape in as many words: 'build it ON sourceVocabularyIssues, not on a second predicate, or they drift'. This change does exactly that: a new --component-source-vocabulary mode in cmd/config-key-audit calling the birth gate's own function, on the estate's Go-native daily-check-image pattern (ten such images now, most recently capped-schedule-ordering-check). A Python mirror pinned by a parity test was considered and rejected: it IS a second predicate, and can only detect drift where calling the function makes drift unrepresentable. The 69 pre-existing findings cannot be zeroed in one commit — repairing ONE of them (migration 478) took an owner ruling and a shrink-guard incident — so they are grandfathered by a FROZEN baseline that can only shrink, keyed on the exact (component_id, field, source, class) tuple so it can never become an all-clear for a component, and dated so it cannot be appended to. The baseline governs the EXIT CODE and never the REPORT: the daily doc_notes row names all 69 every morning.

plan.summary: bugs_open/309's last open half. The source-vocabulary BIRTH gate (CLC-018) refuses a generated component that declares a data source the platform cannot resolve, and it is holding — zero offenders born since it went live. But nothing has ever asked the same question of the components ALREADY in the database, and the birth gate structurally never can, because a component is routinely inserted or altered by a hand-written migration that never passes through the Go action. MEASURED today: 69 fields across 17 active components declare a source that resolves nowhere, six of them live on 46 page instances. This adds a daily at-rest audit that CALLS the birth gate's own function — not a mirror of it — on the estate's Go-native check-image pattern, with a frozen shrink-only baseline that grandfathers the 69 without ever silencing a 70th. Docs shipped alongside and deliberately NOT listed as edits (council scope is platform code, and prose must not spend credits): a concept-register entry CLC-025 relating this to CLC-018 as the same rule on the other door; a new bugs_open file owning the 69 repairs, which every baseline row names by path so a grandfathered finding is ROUTED rather than excused; and the lane's PLAN/NOTES/RUNBOOK carrying the census query, its four measurement gotchas and the five mutation proofs.

edits.rationale: Export the rule so the audit can CALL it, and return it as data so the audit does not have to parse a class back out of a human-readable message (which would be a second predicate wearing the first one's clothes). SourceVocabularyIssues is kept as a thin projection over SourceVocabularyFindings, so the birth gate's behaviour is provably unchanged - its existing tests pass untouched.

edits.rationale: The at-rest audit. Reads content_components (scoped explicitly - 56 tables carry that column and 54 are backups) plus the live aspect set plus a live-instance join, runs actions.SourceVocabularyFindings, and grades each offence against the frozen baseline. Reuses dbConn() and writeDocNote() from fleetdb.go and the exit-code discipline of emitCommitShaExposure rather than inventing either.

The frozen grandfather baseline, GENERATED from the census query rather than hand-typed. 69 entries, each carrying live_instances_at_baseline and a route naming the file that owns its repair. It exists so the job is green on day one by MEASUREMENT rather than by hope, and so a red is always either a real new finding or a one-line trim - never a standing backlog, which is what trains people to ignore a check.

plan.risks: (1) THE BASELINE IS THE RISK SURFACE: an allow-list that silences the detector it belongs to is a recorded failure on this estate (scripts/pattern-check.py's COMPONENT_WRITE_ALLOWED note). Three structural defences, all mutation-proven rather than asserted: the key is the exact (component_id, field, source, class) tuple, so a NEW bad field on an already-baselined component with 32 live instances is RED (mutation M1: drop `field` from baselineKey -> TestBaselineKeyIsNarrow fails); the loader REFUSES any entry not dated 2026-08-22, so the file cannot be appended to (M2: remove the date check -> TestBaselineIsClosed fails); and the baseline governs the EXIT CODE only — the daily doc_notes body names all 69 every run, so it cannot go quiet. Check these. (2) FAIL-OPEN ASYMMETRY, deliberate and worth a reviewer's eye: the birth gate SKIPS the aspect half when site_specs is unreadable (it must not block all generation); this audit exits 2 instead. An audit has nothing to block, and a report that silently skipped a third of its rule is the blind-pass landmine one rung higher — the trap this very lane shipped and had to correct on 2026-08-21 (85c70c24a). Do not 'make the callers consistent'. (3) VACUITY: two refusals that fail in OPPOSITE directions, both exit 2 — zero components is the silence (0 findings reads clean), zero aspects is the FLOOD (every site_specs.* source reads phantom). A reviewer should check that neither can return 0/1. (4) The exported rename touches the live birth gate; its behaviour must be unchanged. SourceVocabularyIssues is now a thin projection over SourceVocabularyFindings and the gate's pre-existing tests pass untouched, which is the evidence. (5) NOT DONE, deliberately: the 69 repairs (each a per-component judgement — repairing ONE took an owner ruling and a shrink-guard incident), and no work-item production, because detection->dispatch is the estate's known-broken half (bugs_open/083, and bugs_open/358 for this exact channel).
